column1: # The test commands of the Tcl test binary that block the tests of the
# bucket `internals`. tools/suite-md.py counts the tests of each one.
# Columns: command, path, what the tests check.
# Paths: `C package` (Tcl's own test command, built as a C package on
# the stubs of ztcl), `runner` (a stand-in in tools/suite_cmds.zig),
# `design` (the tests check the internal layout of Tcl and stay out).

column3: The state of the channel layer: buffered bytes, queued output, reference counts, and the cut and splice of a channel between threads.
Hash tables of the C API with a custom key type.
The file name rules of Windows on Unix: `file join`, `file split`, and `glob` of another platform.
Tcl_Obj types, reference counts, and shimmering through the C API.
The token tree of Tcl_ParseExpr.
Tcl_UtfNext on bytes that are not valid UTF-8.
Tcl_UtfPrev on bytes that are not valid UTF-8.
The digit generation of TclDoubleDigits, an internal stub.
The token tree of Tcl_ParseCommand.
The `memory` command of a build with TCL_MEM_DEBUG. The leak tests compare `memory info` before and after a script.
Tcl_DString of the C API.
Byte arrays with bytes that are not valid UTF-8.
A test that needs any command of the Tcl test binary.
Tcl_GetIndexFromObj and its cache in the Tcl_Obj.
The depth of the native C stack of Tcl's non-recursive engine (NRE). ztcl has no NRE.
Tcl_LinkVar of C variables.
Tcl_QueueEvent at the head, the tail, or a mark of the queue.
A change of the permission bits of a file, for the setup of a test.
Tcl_CreateFileHandler on pipes.
Math functions that C code makes with Tcl_CreateMathFunc.
The C test package pkgua for `load` and `unload`.
Events that run in a second interpreter.
The event queue of the main thread, through `testthread event` of the Tcl test binary.
`testregexp` exists in tools/suite_cmds.zig. The flag REG_EXPECT, the place where a partial match ends, has no stand-in.
